CustomField.description: Running stock for this model: how many cars are available and how many are reserved. Sold out when none are left.
CustomField.formula: IF(Available_Stock__c = 0, IF(Reserved_Stock__c = 0, "Sold out", "Sold out · Reserved (" & TEXT(Reserved_Stock__c) & ")"), "Available (" & TEXT(Available_Stock__c) & ")" & IF(Reserved_Stock__c = 0, "", " · Reserved (" & TEXT(Reserved_Stock__c) & ")"))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Cars available to sell now, and cars reserved for customers.
CustomField.label: AM Stock
